[Story]
Xiao Ming promised his mom to help tidy up the desk at home, but he left in a hurry and forgot that he hadn't finished tidying up completely. When he returns home, his mom asks, "Is the desk tidied up?" Xiao Ming thinks for a moment and says, "It's tidied up."

[Question]
Why does Xiao Ming say this?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Xiao Ming forgets that he tidies up but does not completely tidy up the desk.
B. Xiao Ming thinks he completely tidies up the desk because he usually does.
C. Xiao Ming intentionally lies because he does not want his mother to get angry.
D. Xiao Ming intentionally lies because he wants to continue doing what he likes.
